lore.common: Drops one last stubborn grain after time is up, so every argument about who won starts all over again.
lore.uncommon: Pours its sand into a perfect little pyramid at the bottom, and refuses to be turned over until someone admires it.
lore.rare: Slows its sand down whenever someone is losing, and speeds up when they're winning.
lore.epic: Leaked through a crack at the beach until the whole beach was inside its bottom bulb. The lifeguard is waiting for someone to turn it over.
lore.legendary: Was turned over at the start of a picnic and the sand stopped halfway, so the afternoon lasted all summer.

names.legendary: Captain Stickybrave of the First Aid Box

lore.common: Pulls out every little hair when it's peeled off.
lore.uncommon: Has cartoon animals printed on it, so children ask for one even without a scratch.
lore.rare: Sticks so hard that it held a torn kite together through a gale. Getting it off afterwards took the whole family and a bath.
lore.epic: Came out of a giant box and stuck the whole playground together, swing to slide and slide to teacher. Break lasted until home time.
lore.legendary: Patched a crack in the old town dam with one strip. The dam still holds, and it still has a cartoon dinosaur on it.

lore.common: Gets tapped on the glass every morning to make its needle move.
lore.uncommon: Hangs in the hall with a shiny brass face and words like Fair and Stormy.
lore.rare: Taps its own glass until the needle points at Stormy, and the storm turns up to match. Mostly uses it to cancel PE.
lore.epic: Dropped its needle so far that the whole village tied down its washing, its bins and one very surprised goat.
lore.legendary: Pointed at Fair so stubbornly that a storm cloud gave up and went round the town. The next town over is still damp.

names.legendary: The Mirror That Saw Everything Behind

lore.common: Folds itself back when brushed by a passing cyclist.
lore.uncommon: Shows objects closer than they appear, which makes parking a nightmare.
lore.rare: Folds itself in to squeeze through gaps narrower than the car. The car is far less sure about this.
lore.epic: Folded in every mirror on the street at once like a row of shy ears, and the bin lorry squeezed through the lane for the first time ever.
lore.legendary: Saw a lost dog trotting behind the car for three streets, and reunited it with its family.

lore.common: Gets knocked over by the cat chasing its own tail.
lore.uncommon: Has brass legs that get too hot to touch.
lore.rare: Catches sparks and throws them back into the fire like a goalkeeper. It has started shouting SAVE every time.
lore.epic: Glowed so cosily that the cat, the dog and grandad fell asleep against it in a row, and nobody could reach the fire to add a log.
lore.legendary: Blocked a spark the size of a football, spun it round and sent it back up the chimney. The neighbours thought it was a firework.

lore.common: Snaps in half the first time it's struck.
lore.uncommon: Flares up with a fizz that makes everyone step back.
lore.rare: Glues itself to other matchsticks overnight. The family woke up to a matchstick staircase leading straight to the biscuit tin.
lore.epic: Was dropped into a jar of ten thousand toothpicks, and the family spent a whole week hunting for the one with the red head.
lore.legendary: Was struck by a grown-up in a pitch-dark cave and lit it up so well that the bats asked for it to be switched off.

names.legendary: The Dial That Counted to the Moon

lore.common: Clicks its numbers so slowly that the children count with it.
lore.uncommon: Has a trip counter that nobody ever resets, so every family holiday is officially four thousand miles long.
lore.rare: Rolls its numbers backwards whenever the car reverses. Grandad now drives home backwards to make the car younger.
lore.epic: Rolled over to all zeros on the motorway, so the car decided it was brand new and asked for its first service all over again.
lore.legendary: Counted enough miles to drive to the moon and back, all in one old family car.

lore.common: Pops off with a loud slurp at exactly the wrong moment.
lore.uncommon: Thumps up and down in the sink until something gurgles.
lore.rare: Sticks to anything flat and will not let go: the fridge, the window, the dog's water bowl. Grown-ups now carry the glass table with it.
lore.epic: Pulled so hard on the bath drain that the whole bath came up instead. The rubber duck is still in it, on the landing.
lore.legendary: Rescued a lost wedding ring from the drain with one mighty pull.

lore.common: Has one leg that's always shorter than the others.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on the sand so every photo tilts slightly.
lore.rare: Stands so still that birds land on it, a dog barked at it and a man tried to post a letter in it.
lore.epic: Spread its legs so wide on the busy pier that the whole queue for the ice cream van had to limbo underneath it.
lore.legendary: Held a camera still all night to catch the stars spinning. The photo shows perfect stars and one very confused moth.

lore.common: Gets spotted with toothpaste every single morning.
lore.uncommon: Shows its owner their morning face, which nobody wants to see.
lore.rare: Makes a small room look twice as big, and the cat keeps trying to walk into it.
lore.epic: Covered the whole dance studio wall, and every dancer could see what everyone else was doing wrong.
lore.legendary: Copied its owner so well that the reflection went to school one morning instead. Nobody noticed until it wrote everything backwards.

lore.common: Shows a wiggly green line that everyone pretends to understand.
lore.uncommon: Has so many knobs that every visitor twists one, and the line jumps off the screen.
lore.rare: Draws the wiggly line of any sound and then plays it back wrong. It turned the head teacher's speech into a duck.
lore.epic: Drew every voice in assembly as a squiggle, and the squiggles tangled so badly that the caretaker untied them with a broom.
lore.legendary: Found the hum in a broken radio, then the hum in the fridge, then the hum in grandad. Grandad was just humming.

lore.common: Gets caught in trees and flaps there for months.
lore.uncommon: Lives in another bag full of bags under the kitchen sink.
lore.rare: Floats away on the wind like a jellyfish and lands on the beach.
lore.epic: Blew out of every bin in the car park and joined up into one giant bag that tried to carry the supermarket home.
lore.legendary: Was reused so many times that it now goes to the shop by itself, picks the cheapest bread and comes home alone.

lore.common: Buzzes your wrist every five minutes about something you don't care about.
lore.uncommon: Tells you to stand up every time you sit down.
lore.rare: Tells everyone at breakfast how badly you slept.
lore.epic: Buzzed every wrist in the cinema at the scariest moment, and the whole audience screamed at their own arms instead of the film.
lore.legendary: Talked its owner into ten thousand steps a day, then a hundred thousand. They are now somewhere in Scotland, still being buzzed.

names.legendary: The Roll That Never Ran Out

lore.common: Runs out exactly when you need it most.
lore.uncommon: Is always hung the wrong way round, according to someone in the house.
lore.rare: Rolls itself back up perfectly after the cat has finished, so nobody ever believes the cat did anything.
lore.epic: Was unrolled by the puppy through the whole house, out the door and round the garden.
lore.legendary: Lasted a whole month in a family of six, which nobody can explain.

lore.common: Bangs its lid at night when the wind blows.
lore.uncommon: Smells so bad on hot days that the flies queue up.
lore.rare: Locks its own lid the moment the fox arrives. The fox now leaves angry notes on the doormat.
lore.epic: Rolled down the hill on bin day and knocked over every other bin on the street.
lore.legendary: Ate so much at the street party that it burped, and the burp blew the bunting into the next street.

lore.common: Ticks so loudly at night that nobody can sleep.
lore.uncommon: Runs five minutes fast, so the whole family is always early.
lore.rare: Slows down during the last lesson of the day so it lasts forever.
lore.epic: Fell off the hall wall, and every clock in the school stopped to look. Nobody knew what time it was until Thursday.
lore.legendary: Ran backwards for one afternoon, and the whole class got an extra hour of art.

lore.common: Gets its slats tangled so half point up and half point down.
lore.uncommon: Has one cord that does everything, and whichever way it is pulled, the slats spin like a fan.
lore.rare: Lets the morning sun stripe across your face at five in the morning.
lore.epic: Snapped up with a bang at the sleepover, and every child woke up at once.
lore.legendary: Tilted its slats so exactly that it spelled HELLO in sunlight on the living-room floor. The cat has slept in the O ever since.

lore.common: Slips off one hook so it droops at the corner.
lore.uncommon: Is the first place every child hides during hide and seek, with their feet showing.
lore.rare: Gathers every lost thing in the house in its folds: socks, keys, a whole birthday present. It hands them back only when it is washed.
lore.epic: Swished open so dramatically at the school play that the audience clapped, and the actors had not even come on yet.
lore.legendary: Blocked the draughts so well one winter that the radiators got bored and went on holiday.

lore.common: Has a handle that sticks every winter.
lore.uncommon: Has two handles, and everyone tries the wrong one first, every single time.
lore.rare: Swings open in the breeze and knocks over the plant pot.
lore.epic: Was flung open for the summer party, and the whole garden came inside.
lore.legendary: Opened so wide on the first warm day that it let summer in early, and the snowman in the garden asked to come inside.

lore.common: Snaps its letterbox on your fingers when you post a card.
lore.uncommon: Needs its key jiggled just right before it opens.
lore.rare: Swings open just as you knock, so you fall into the hall.
lore.epic: Was painted on a hot day and held every party guest stuck to it like flypaper, so the whole party happened on the doorstep.
lore.legendary: Spotted the family car at the end of the road, opened itself, boiled the kettle and laid out the slippers before anyone got out.

lore.common: Rumbles so loudly when opening that the whole street hears it.
lore.uncommon: Opens by itself whenever an aeroplane flies over, so the street always knows when the four o'clock flight is late.
lore.rare: Rolls up so fast that it flings whatever is on top onto the roof: frisbees, footballs and once a very startled cat.
lore.epic: Rolled up so fast that the car, the bikes and the paddling pool rolled out onto the road, and the street held a yard sale.
lore.legendary: Rolled up so high once that it kept going, over the roof and down the other side. The house now has a garage door at both ends.

lore.common: Gets walked into by people who think it's open.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in nose and hand prints at exactly toddler height.
lore.rare: Reflects so perfectly that the dog spent a whole afternoon barking at the dog on the other side. They are now best friends.
lore.epic: Was polished so perfectly that a whole flock of pigeons queued politely outside it, waiting for it to open.
lore.legendary: Was polished so perfectly that a goose walked into it, honked at it for an hour and has since adopted its reflection.

names.legendary: The Curtain With a Hundred Ducks

lore.common: Clings to your legs while you shower like a wet ghost.
lore.uncommon: Grows a little black line at the bottom that nobody can scrub off.
lore.rare: Billows inward whenever someone sings in the shower, as if it wants to join in. It mostly wants the high notes.
lore.epic: Let so much water out in one shower that the kitchen ceiling started to drizzle, and the dog downstairs got a shower too.
lore.legendary: Kept a hundred printed ducks for so long that one of them learned to swim off the curtain and float in the bath.

lore.common: Bangs against the wall all night in the slightest breeze, like someone knocking to be let in.
lore.uncommon: Has slats that sparrows love to nest behind, so opening the window means meeting a dozen cross sparrows.
lore.rare: Slams itself shut faster than a wasp can fly in. The wasps have started booking ahead.
lore.epic: Slammed shut along the whole seafront at once, and the bang knocked every seagull's chips into the sea.
lore.legendary: Closed so tightly that it stayed night-time inside the house for a week, and the owls moved in for the holiday.

lore.common: Patters so loudly in the rain that nobody can sleep.
lore.uncommon: Shows the stars from bed on a clear night.
lore.rare: Collects leaves in autumn until the room goes dark.
lore.epic: Collected so much snow on top that it all slid off in one go and buried the snowman, the car and the postman.
lore.legendary: Let in so much sunshine that the attic grew a lemon tree. The family now has the only attic in town with a harvest.

lore.common: Sticks shut on the hottest day of the year and swings open on the coldest night.
lore.uncommon: Lets in every fly in summer and won't let them out.
lore.rare: Makes everyone in class look outside instead of at the board.
lore.epic: Opened in a gust that blew every school report out of the classroom and across town. Several parents have still not seen theirs.
lore.legendary: Steamed up so beautifully one winter morning that the finger drawing on it was hung in the town gallery. The gallery keeps a kettle beside it.

lore.common: Rattles in its frame every time a lorry goes by.
lore.uncommon: Drips condensation down onto the windowsill every morning.
lore.rare: Lets in a thin draught that blows out every candle.
lore.epic: Was hammered by hailstones so big that it caught one, and the family kept it in the freezer as a pet.
lore.legendary: Survived a cricket ball, a hailstorm and a pigeon at full speed, and now wears a tiny sign that says UNDEFEATED.

lore.common: Unravels down the corridor as you walk.
lore.uncommon: Is wrapped so many times round a tiny cut that the finger looks like a sausage.
lore.rare: Turns any child into a mummy in under a minute.
lore.epic: Wrapped up a whole snowman during a game of doctors, and the snowman refused to melt until he felt better.
lore.legendary: Wrapped a wobbly old bridge in the park so tightly that it stopped wobbling. The ducks still use it every morning.

lore.common: Has a light above it that hums like a bee every time someone brushes their teeth.
lore.uncommon: Gets messages written in the steam that appear again next time.
lore.rare: Shows tomorrow's bed hair tonight, so everyone goes to bed in a bad mood.
lore.epic: Steamed up so thickly that the whole family brushed their teeth by guessing, and grandad brushed his with the hairbrush.
lore.legendary: Learned every song ever sung in front of it and released them as an album of foggy humming. Its biggest fans are toothbrushes.

lore.common: Spills over the moment it's filled to the top.
lore.uncommon: Has measurements on the side that are never quite right.
lore.rare: Holds any amount without overflowing, so the class poured in a whole bucket and it still says 100 ml.
lore.epic: Measured so many things in one lesson that it measured the teacher, the hamster and the school pond. The pond came to exactly four beakers.
lore.legendary: Measured exactly one litre of thunderstorm, and the classroom has had its own small cloud ever since.

lore.common: Has buttons that nobody dares press.
lore.uncommon: Sprays water when you least expect it.
lore.rare: Warms itself up so nicely that nobody wants to leave the bathroom.
lore.epic: Sprayed every visitor at the hotel who pressed the wrong button.
lore.legendary: Pressed its own buttons all night and invented a new one, a tiny tune when the lid closes. Now the whole hotel wants one.

names.legendary: The Bag That Made It to the Lorry

lore.common: Drips something mysterious down your leg on the way to the bin.
lore.uncommon: Is tied so full that the knot won't close, so it wears its rubbish like a hat.
lore.rare: Grows a little bigger every time someone says 'just one more thing'. It now holds a whole broken deckchair.
lore.epic: Split open on bin day and covered the whole pavement in yoghurt pots.
lore.legendary: Made it from the kitchen to the bin lorry without a single tear, which no bag has ever done.

lore.common: Rubs the back of your neck until it's red.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself into a knot in the bottom of the bag.
lore.rare: Swings its binoculars round like a lasso whenever a rare bird appears, so nobody ever gets to see the bird.
lore.epic: Slipped open on a cliff walk, and the binoculars rolled all the way down to the beach, where a seal was found using them.
lore.legendary: Held its binoculars so still for so long that a woodpecker mistook them for a tree and nested in the case.

lore.common: Points itself at the sky the moment your coin drops in, so you get ten seconds of cloud.
lore.uncommon: Points at the sea, the sky and the same seagull every time.
lore.rare: Zooms so far that it saw someone eating chips in France, and every seagull on the pier set off at once.
lore.epic: Swivelled round in a gust and showed the whole queue the inside of the ice cream van. The van sold out by lunch.
lore.legendary: Stared at the horizon for so long that it finally saw the edge of the world, and refuses to tell anyone what is there.

lore.common: Lights itself again every time the birthday child blows it out.
lore.uncommon: Dribbles wax onto the icing so the first slice has a crunchy bit.
lore.rare: Grants exactly one wish a year, but only if every flame goes out in one breath.
lore.epic: Had so many lit on grandpa's cake that the smoke alarm sang the birthday song.
lore.legendary: Burned on a ninety-ninth birthday cake, and the birthday girl blew them all out first try.

lore.common: Sends its smoke in whatever direction you move your chair.
lore.uncommon: Spits sparks into the sky like a little firework display of its own.
lore.rare: Sends up a column of smoke so tall that the weather forecaster marked it on the map as a cloud.
lore.epic: Crackled so loudly on bonfire night that the fireworks had to wait their turn.
lore.legendary: Was built so cosy by the grown-ups that a pigeon nested on top, and bonfire night waited until the chicks could fly.

lore.common: Turns every marshmallow into a black lump the moment it gets near.
lore.uncommon: Tumbles a log over in the middle of the best story.
lore.rare: Pops a loud spark exactly at the scariest moment of every ghost story.
lore.epic: Got the whole campsite singing round it until the owls asked for quiet.
lore.legendary: Burned so cosily at the campsite that the tents shuffled closer in the night, and everyone woke up in one big tent pile.

lore.common: Gets its button slapped so hard that it slides across the table.
lore.uncommon: Drops its little red flag the moment someone runs out of time.
lore.rare: Ticks faster whenever the player is thinking hard.
lore.epic: Got its two sides muddled and made both players wait for each other all afternoon. Their pizza arrived, went cold and was eaten by the referee.
lore.legendary: Timed a game so long that the players finished it the next morning in their pyjamas.

lore.common: Clicks open in the handbag and gets powder everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Has two mirrors, one that makes your nose look enormous.
lore.rare: Flashes sunlight into anyone's eyes across a whole playground. Uses it to point out spinach in people's teeth.
lore.epic: Bounced the sun so hard off the beach that the lifeguard thought it was a shark signal and cleared the whole sea.
lore.legendary: Was used to signal a passing ship from a stranded rowing boat, and the ship turned round.

lore.common: Smells like old banana skins on warm days.
lore.uncommon: Is the busiest worm hotel in the garden.
lore.rare: Turns banana skins into soil overnight, so nobody can finish a banana before it has been composted.
lore.epic: Grew so many surprise tomato plants that the whole garden became a jungle.
lore.legendary: Grew a pumpkin so big on its own that the family now uses it as a garden shed. The worms pop round for tea.

lore.common: Misses the bin every single time it's thrown.
lore.uncommon: Gets unfolded later because someone realises the idea was good after all.
lore.rare: Turns into a perfect ball for office basketball.
lore.epic: Unfolded itself in the bin and turned out to be the map for the school fair. The whole school dug through the bin to find the bouncy castle.
lore.legendary: Was uncrumpled years later and found to hold the first draft of a famous song.

lore.common: Shouts cuckoo at midnight and wakes the whole house.
lore.uncommon: Has pinecone-shaped weights on chains that need pulling every day.
lore.rare: Pops its little bird out so fast that it surprises the cat every hour.
lore.epic: Cuckooed so convincingly at midnight that a real cuckoo moved in and laid an egg behind the little door.
lore.legendary: Popped its bird out so hard one noon that the bird flew off, toured the forest for a week and came back with a friend.

lore.common: Glows so red in the dark that you can read by it.
lore.uncommon: Flashes 12:00 for weeks after every power cut, and the whole family has given up resetting it.
lore.rare: Beeps louder each time it's ignored.
lore.epic: Beeped so loudly through the wall that the neighbours got up, got dressed and went to work on a Saturday.
lore.legendary: Woke up a bear at the zoo three weeks before spring. The bear now has its own snooze button.

lore.common: Sticks every time you try to open it with full hands.
lore.uncommon: Is always on the opposite side to the one you expected, so everyone pats the door like a lost cat.
lore.rare: Gives a tiny static shock to everyone wearing woolly socks.
lore.epic: Gave a whole office a static shock at once on woolly jumper day, and everyone's hair stood up for the team photo.
lore.legendary: Shocked a passing thundercloud by mistake, and the thundercloud has kept away from the house ever since.

lore.common: Thuds so loudly that the whole house jumps.
lore.uncommon: Has a brass lion's face that stares at every visitor.
lore.rare: Echoes down the hallway so the knock sounds like three people.
lore.epic: Was knocked so hard that the door next door opened instead, and the two families have swapped houses ever since.
lore.legendary: Knocked so loudly once that the whole house woke up and walked to the seaside. It came back sunburnt.

lore.common: Rattles when you turn it, as if it's about to fall off.
lore.uncommon: Comes off in your hand at the worst moment.
lore.rare: Locks itself whenever someone says the word bath. Children have been using it for years.
lore.epic: Turned the wrong way so stubbornly that the whole family went in and out through the cat flap all weekend.
lore.legendary: Was turned so often that it unscrewed the whole front door, which walked off to find a quieter house.

lore.common: Slams its lid so loudly that the whole alley echoes.
lore.uncommon: Is a restaurant for every rat, fox and seagull in town.
lore.rare: Swallows anything left near it, including a parked bike and a builder's lunch. It will not give the lunch back.
lore.epic: Was filled by every stall after market day, and the bin lorry needed two trips.
lore.legendary: Was emptied so rarely that it grew a little roof garden, and the market traders now eat their lunch up there.

names.legendary: The Lift That Never Stopped at Four

lore.common: Plays the same tinny tune every single journey.
lore.uncommon: Has every button pressed by a small child.
lore.rare: Gets stuck between floors for exactly as long as it takes to panic.
lore.epic: Squeezed in so many workers at nine o'clock that the doors closed on a tie, and the tie rode up and down all morning without its owner.
lore.legendary: Has carried a million people up and down the same building and still won't stop at the fourth floor.

lore.common: Keeps one log that will not burn, no matter how many times the grown-ups turn it over.
lore.uncommon: Toasts everyone's feet while their backs freeze.
lore.rare: Glows so warmly that the cats from three gardens away come to sit by it.
lore.epic: Kept the November garden party so warm that everyone forgot it was November, and somebody got the paddling pool out.
lore.legendary: Glowed so warmly one winter night that the frost on the whole street gave up, and next door's roses bloomed in January.

lore.common: Sends soot down the chimney onto the clean rug.
lore.uncommon: Spits a little ember out onto the hearth rug every evening.
lore.rare: Blows its smoke back down the chimney whenever someone opens a window, so the whole room smells like a kipper.
lore.epic: Warmed the house so well during the snowstorm that the snowman outside melted, walked in and asked to sit closer.
lore.legendary: Burned one log so slowly that it lasted the whole winter. The log is now part of the family and has its own chair.

lore.common: Comes in a box with a picture far more exciting than the firework inside.
lore.uncommon: Bangs so loudly that every dog in the street hides.
lore.rare: Paints the sky with colours that hang there for a whole second.
lore.epic: Burst into a shape so like a giant ice cream that the whole crowd went to the van at once, and the van ran out.
lore.legendary: Exploded into a shape so perfect that the whole town still argues whether it was a smiley face.

lore.common: Has a thousand plasters and none in the right size.
lore.uncommon: Is green with a white cross so everyone can find it.
lore.rare: Hides its little scissors so nobody can find them when needed.
lore.epic: Patched up every scraped knee at sports day, and ran out of plasters by the relay.
lore.legendary: Patched up a whole football team, both goalposts and the referee's whistle in one match, and only ran out of lollipops.

names.legendary: Medic Mitzi of the Mountain Path

lore.common: Has a zip that always sticks when someone is crying.
lore.uncommon: Rolls out its gauze bandage across the floor.
lore.rare: Packs itself into every bag, so the family carried seven first aid kits to the beach and no sandwiches.
lore.epic: Unzipped on a windy hilltop, and the bandages flew off like streamers and wrapped up a whole flock of sheep.
lore.legendary: Went up every mountain with the same climber and never had to be used once.

names.legendary: The Flare That Called the Lifeboat

lore.common: Fizzes so brightly that everyone has to look away.
lore.uncommon: Pours out bright red smoke that turns the whole beach pink.
lore.rare: Burns underwater, which nobody believes until the fish start queuing to read by it.
lore.epic: Lit up the bay so brightly during the drill that the lighthouse thought it had been replaced and switched itself off in a huff.
lore.legendary: Called the lifeboat to a stranded fishing boat, and every fisherman got home for tea.

lore.common: Makes everyone check their outfit three times before leaving.
lore.uncommon: Leans against the wall and wobbles when anyone walks past.
lore.rare: Makes the bedroom look like it has twins in it.
lore.epic: Tipped over onto the bed during dressing up, and the bedroom looked like it went on for ever. The cat is still looking for the end.
lore.legendary: Liked one outfit so much that it kept the reflection, and its owner has been wearing an invisible jumper ever since.

lore.common: Gets spun so fast that the countries blur together.
lore.uncommon: Gets stopped by a finger that always lands in the sea.
lore.rare: Lands on a country that its owner can't pronounce.
lore.epic: Was spun so hard in geography that it flew off its stand, rolled out of school and was found two streets away, still pointing at Peru.
lore.legendary: Spun so fast once that the real Earth noticed and joined in, and everyone got an extra five minutes of Tuesday.

lore.common: Bongs a minute late every hour, so the whole house checks their watches.
lore.uncommon: Has to be wound up with a chain every Sunday.
lore.rare: Swings its pendulum so steadily that everyone in the room breathes in time.
lore.epic: Chimed thirteen times at midnight, and the whole house came downstairs to check.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall over the years that it now pokes through the ceiling and keeps the time for the bedroom upstairs too.

lore.common: Hangs its smoke in the room like a curtain.
lore.uncommon: Smells of spice and flowers so strongly that the cat sneezes.
lore.rare: Can make its smoke smell like anything, and it mostly chooses toast when everyone is hungry.
lore.epic: Smoked so much at a tea party that the teapot disappeared, and the guests poured tea into the fog for an hour.
lore.legendary: Drifted its smoke into such perfect shapes that it drew a dragon over the house, and the neighbours came out to wave at it.

lore.common: Hides in the bottom of the school bag until it's needed.
lore.uncommon: Has to be shaken before every puff, and it rattles.
lore.rare: Gives a puff so fresh that its owner can blow out every candle on a cake from across the room.
lore.epic: Went with its owner on the cross-country race, and she finished ahead of the whole class.
lore.legendary: Helped its owner blow up the biggest balloon at the school fair. It lifted the bouncy castle an inch off the ground.

lore.common: Gets peeked through by every curious child in the house.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone miss it with the key in the dark.
lore.rare: Whistles in the wind like a tiny flute.
lore.epic: Was peeked through by every guest at the surprise party, and the surprise was ruined.
lore.legendary: Let a draught through so cold that the soup on the other side froze into a lolly. Grandma ate it anyway.

lore.common: Has a neck so narrow that every bottle brush gets stuck in it.
lore.uncommon: Gets swirled round by everyone who holds it, like a fancy drink.
lore.rare: Changes colour when two liquids are mixed, and the class gasps.
lore.epic: Made a volcano at the science fair that foamed over three tables.
lore.legendary: Brewed a colour so new that the art teacher borrowed it, named it and painted the whole staffroom with it.

names.legendary: The Hill That Became a Park

lore.common: Is covered in seagulls arguing over crusts.
lore.uncommon: Grows a little taller every week as the lorries arrive.
lore.rare: Is so big that the diggers look like toys on top of it.
lore.epic: Slid a little in the rain and pushed the bin lorry back down the hill it had just driven up.
lore.legendary: Was covered in soil and trees and became the town's favourite park. The sledgers still find the odd teapot.

lore.common: Blows down the pavement and lands in someone's garden.
lore.uncommon: Hides in hedges so cleverly that the litter-pickers walk past it every single week.
lore.rare: Escapes the bin in the wind and tours the whole park.
lore.epic: Blew into the goal so many times during one match that the referee named it player of the match.
lore.legendary: Was blown on the wind across three counties, and was finally picked up by a heron building its nest.

lore.common: Makes everything look huge except the one thing you are actually looking for.
lore.uncommon: Makes every bug in the garden look like a monster.
lore.rare: Reads the smallest print on the cereal box.
lore.epic: Made one ant look so huge that the whole class screamed, and the ant had to be calmed down with a crumb.
lore.legendary: Found a lost earring in the carpet, plus four marbles, a baby tooth and an argument from last summer.

lore.common: Makes the holder's eye look enormous to everyone on the other side.
lore.uncommon: Shows every smudge on the window as a huge fingerprint.
lore.rare: Watches the ants so closely that they seem to watch back.
lore.epic: Zoomed in so hard on a crossword clue that the letters ran off the page, and the whole family chased them round the table.
lore.legendary: Solved the mystery of the missing birthday cake by spotting icing on the dog's whiskers.

lore.common: Has bulbs all round it that make the room very hot.
lore.uncommon: Zooms in so close that every freckle looks like a planet.
lore.rare: Hogs all the light in the room, so everyone else is in shadow.
lore.epic: Lit up so brightly that the theatre forgot to switch on the stage lights, and the whole show was performed in the dressing room.
lore.legendary: Made one actor look so dazzling that the whole audience wore sunglasses for the second half.

lore.common: Goes out the moment it's lit, every single time, with a little puff of smoke.
lore.uncommon: Gets damp and won't strike no matter how hard you try.
lore.rare: Lights only for grown-ups. When a child picks up the box, every match inside pretends to be asleep.
lore.epic: Lit every candle in the house during the power cut, and the family played cards by candlelight.
lore.legendary: Was the only match that would light on a soggy campsite, so the grown-ups gave it a round of applause and its own tiny tent.

lore.common: Flickers so close to fingers that grown-ups drop it in the sink.
lore.uncommon: Goes out in the slightest breeze.
lore.rare: Burns in whatever colour the birthday child asks for, held by a grown-up, and it has never once been asked for beige.
lore.epic: Lit the barbecue so slowly that everyone ate the salad, then the bread, then the salad again.
lore.legendary: Stayed lit through a gust of wind long enough to light the lantern that guided everyone home.

names.legendary: The Lens That Found a Tiny Zoo

lore.common: Makes everyone close one eye and squint until their face aches.
lore.uncommon: Has two knobs, and everyone twists the wrong one until the slide cracks.
lore.rare: Shows the pond water is full of wriggling creatures, and nobody drinks from the tap that day.
lore.epic: Showed the class what was living on the school sandwich, and the whole school brought packed lunches for a week.
lore.legendary: Found a tiny new creature in a puddle in the playground, and it was named after the school.

lore.common: Pops out of the eye whenever its wearer raises an eyebrow in surprise.
lore.uncommon: Drops into the teacup at every fancy tea party.
lore.rare: Glints in the light so that everyone thinks the wearer is very clever.
lore.epic: Glinted so cleverly at the fancy dress party that everyone took its wearer for a professor, and he gave an hour-long speech about cheese.
lore.legendary: Was worn by a dog in a costume competition, and the dog has been insufferable ever since.

lore.common: Grows fuzzy spots that nobody wants to look at.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that slides off whenever it's carried.
lore.rare: Grows a different coloured mould in every corner, like a tiny garden.
lore.epic: Was forgotten in the science fridge over the holidays, and the whole class had a very smelly first day back.
lore.legendary: Grew a mould so friendly that it started waving at visitors, and the school had to give it a name badge.

lore.common: Burns a tunnel down its middle so the wick drowns in wax.
lore.uncommon: Drips down one side until it looks like a melting snowman.
lore.rare: Leans its flame towards whoever tells a fib, so the whole dinner table has gone suspiciously quiet.
lore.epic: Lit every table at the candlelit dinner, and the restaurant forgot to turn the lights on.
lore.legendary: Burned so calmly through a thunderstorm that the storm stopped to watch, and the whole town got one quiet evening.

names.legendary: The Loo at the End of the Field

lore.common: Has a door that sticks so you have to shout for help.
lore.uncommon: Always has the longest queue at any event.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that people hold their breath from three metres away.
lore.epic: Was delivered to the wrong field and became the most popular spot among the cows. They queued anyway.
lore.legendary: Survived a whole muddy festival weekend, and still had a toilet roll left on Sunday.

names.legendary: The Toilet That Survived a Storm

lore.common: Arrives on a crane, so the builders have to wait for the crane every time it needs moving.
lore.uncommon: Has a lock that shows engaged even when it's empty.
lore.rare: Has been to more building sites than any of the builders.
lore.epic: Tipped over on its back at the building site, with nobody inside, luckily.
lore.legendary: Stood upright through a gale that blew away three tents, two gazebos and a bouncy castle.

lore.common: Gets carried into the living room at the worst possible moment.
lore.uncommon: Plays a little tune when it's used, and the toddler cheers.
lore.rare: Hides itself whenever the toddler is not in the mood, usually behind the sofa with the remote.
lore.epic: Was celebrated so loudly that the neighbours came round to see what was happening.
lore.legendary: Trained a toddler so well that he started training the dog, and the dog now gets a sticker too.

lore.common: Overflows in a storm before anyone can read it.
lore.uncommon: Gets checked every morning by a grandad who loves telling everyone the number.
lore.rare: Catches so much rain that it keeps the leftovers as its own private pond, with its own private frog.
lore.epic: Filled to the top every day in the wettest week ever, and the garden became a pond.
lore.legendary: Measured so much rain in one storm that the forecaster had to invent a new word for it. The word was BUCKETSPLOSH.

lore.common: Tilts so the driver sees the roof instead of the road.
lore.uncommon: Watches the back seat so closely that every whisper is heard.
lore.rare: Shows what was behind the car five minutes ago, so the driver always knows where the ice cream van was.
lore.epic: Caught the whole back-seat sticker fight on a long drive, and everyone got told off.
lore.legendary: Bounced the sun so sharply into a speed camera that the camera took a photo of itself.

names.legendary: The Heap That Hid a Bicycle

lore.common: Grows a new sofa on top every week, and nobody ever sees who brings it.
lore.uncommon: Has a pram, a lamp and a rocking horse sticking out of it, and the rocking horse rocks in the wind.
lore.rare: Hides a treasure in every corner for those brave enough to look.
lore.epic: Was searched by the whole family looking for a lost ring, and they found three bikes and a teapot.
lore.legendary: Hid a perfectly good bicycle that a boy repaired and rode for ten years.

lore.common: Gets knocked over so the sand runs the wrong way.
lore.uncommon: Tilts on its stand so the timing is always a bit off.
lore.rare: Stops its sand whenever the tea is not ready, so every cup is perfect and every guest is very late.
lore.epic: Timed the eggs so badly at breakfast that the eggs hatched first. The chicks are called Three Minutes and Four Minutes.
lore.legendary: Was turned over so many times that it ran out of sand and started timing with sugar. Every cup of tea now arrives sweeter.

lore.common: Mixes its smell with dinner, so the house smells of lavender lasagne.
lore.uncommon: Says sea breeze on the label but smells like washing powder.
lore.rare: Smells of whatever you wish for, so the family all wished at once and the house smelled of pizza, roses and wet dog.
lore.epic: Was lit in every room for spa night, and the smells mixed into one so strong that the dog sneezed itself out of the door.
lore.legendary: Smelled so much like summer that the tulips came up in December to check. They went back down very cross.

names.legendary: The Skip That Ate a Whole House

lore.common: Takes up the whole driveway, so cars have to park on the grass.
lore.uncommon: Fills up with the neighbours' junk the moment it's delivered.
lore.rare: Gets a wheelbarrow tipped into it every five minutes.
lore.epic: Was filled with every old sofa on the street in one weekend, and the neighbours climbed up and sat on it to watch the football.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a whole house's worth of rubbish during a renovation, and still had room for a bathtub.

names.legendary: The Globe With a Real Winter Inside

lore.common: Gets shaken so hard that the little snowman falls over.
lore.uncommon: Swirls its snow round and round until everyone gets dizzy.
lore.rare: Makes it snow in the room around it, but only on whoever shook it too hard.
lore.epic: Was shaken by every child in the shop, and the shelf turned into a blizzard.
lore.legendary: Was shaken on a hot summer's day, and the whole room felt chilly for an hour.

names.legendary: The Can That Was Recycled Forever

lore.common: Gets squashed flat by every passing car.
lore.uncommon: Gets kicked along the pavement by every bored child.
lore.rare: Rattles down the street in the wind like a tiny drum.
lore.epic: Rattled down the high street on a windy day, and half the town marched behind it thinking it was a parade.
lore.legendary: Was recycled so many times that it has been a bike, a can, a plane and a can again.

lore.common: Fizzes so close to your gloves that everyone tells you to hold it further away.
lore.uncommon: Writes your name in the air, which disappears before anyone can read it.
lore.rare: Throws sparks in every direction like a tiny fountain of stars.
lore.epic: Was waved so wildly by the grown-ups that they forgot how to stop, and the neighbours thought there was a disco next door.
lore.legendary: Fizzed so brightly at the garden party that the stars blinked first and went to bed early.

lore.common: Stops working every time a cloud goes past.
lore.uncommon: Points its shadow at the time, but always an hour off in summer.
lore.rare: Moves its shadow to whatever time it likes, so in this garden it is always half past ice cream.
lore.epic: Cast such a long shadow at sunset that the garden party thought it was bedtime and went home before the cake.
lore.legendary: Told the time so confidently one cloudy day that the sun came out to check, and has never been late since.

lore.common: Makes everyone look away the moment they see it.
lore.uncommon: Is over in a quick scratch before anyone has time to say ouch.
lore.rare: Makes even the most nervous child feel brave afterwards, especially with a sticker.
lore.epic: Was so gentle at the school check-up that the loudest crier only noticed when it was time for the sticker.
lore.legendary: Gave a nervous elephant at the zoo its check-up so gently that the elephant asked for a sticker too.

names.legendary: The Light Behind a Hundred Lanterns

lore.common: Burns out in an hour and leaves a little tin cup behind.
lore.uncommon: Floats in a bowl of water like a tiny boat.
lore.rare: Hops between lanterns when nobody is looking, so the lantern you just lit goes dark and the one behind you glows.
lore.epic: Lined the garden path so prettily that the hedgehogs used it as a runway all night.
lore.legendary: Lit a hundred paper lanterns at the river festival, and the fish came up to read the wishes written on them.

names.legendary: The Telescope That Found a New Star

lore.common: Gets pointed at the neighbour's chimney instead of the stars.
lore.uncommon: Shows everything upside down, which takes ages to get used to.
lore.rare: Sees so far that it spotted next week's weather and spoiled the surprise for everyone.
lore.epic: Was pointed the wrong way at the star party, and fifty children spent an hour admiring a very surprised owl.
lore.legendary: Spotted a new comet before anyone else, and the comet was named after the girl who looked.

lore.common: Is put down on the table and rolls straight off.
lore.uncommon: Has a rubber bung so tight that it shoots across the room when it finally comes out.
lore.rare: Makes anything inside it ten times bigger, so the teacher keeps the cress seeds well away from it.
lore.epic: Got mixed up with every other tube in the lab and made a smell so strong that the lesson finished on the playing field.
lore.legendary: Held a sample of the sea so well that tiny waves still crash inside it, and seagulls follow anyone who carries it.

lore.common: Has one hole that is always a bit too small, so one tube has to stand on tiptoe.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on the bench so all the tubes rattle.
lore.rare: Keeps every tube in alphabetical order, even unlabelled ones, and argues with the teacher about it.
lore.epic: Held every experiment at the science fair in one long row, and when one tube fizzed, the whole row fizzed in a wave.
lore.legendary: Held twelve tubes perfectly still while the whole sports day ran through the lab by mistake.

lore.common: Tickles under your tongue and makes you giggle.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when it's done, but never when you expect.
lore.rare: Always says you're perfectly fine just as you were hoping for a day off.
lore.epic: Was so honest during flu season that the whole class went back to school, including the hamster, who had been faking.
lore.legendary: Took the temperature of a summer heatwave and told it to go to bed. The heatwave left early.

lore.common: Gurgles so loudly while refilling that the whole house hears.
lore.uncommon: Takes so long to refill that the next person waits outside humming the whole time.
lore.rare: Drips from its overflow pipe onto the garden path.
lore.epic: Refilled so eagerly one night that the water came up the pipes and made the kitchen tap gargle a tune.
lore.legendary: Sang while refilling so beautifully that the neighbours recorded it, and it now has more listeners than the radio.

lore.common: Springs its little bar out and onto the floor when you change the roll.
lore.uncommon: Sits empty for days because nobody wants to change the roll.
lore.rare: Hides the spare roll somewhere new every week, and only gives clues.
lore.epic: Spun so fast during one sneeze that the roll wrapped the bathroom like a cocoon, and the family had to snip its way out.
lore.legendary: Turned itself the right way round overnight in every house on the street, and ended a hundred family arguments.

lore.common: Slides off the seat whenever someone sits down.
lore.uncommon: Is so fluffy that it looks like a small sheep.
lore.rare: Grows its fluff overnight, and by Friday the whole seat is lost inside a woolly cloud.
lore.epic: Was put on every toilet in the house, and the visiting sheepdog spent the whole holiday trying to herd them.
lore.legendary: Grew so fluffy that it was sheared at the farm show, and its wool knitted a scarf for every grandad on the street.

lore.common: Rattles its heavy lid whenever someone walks past.
lore.uncommon: Keeps running water all night until someone jiggles the handle.
lore.rare: Has a float inside that everyone fiddles with but nobody understands.
lore.epic: Dropped its heavy lid with a bang so loud that the whole hotel came out in their dressing gowns for a fire drill.
lore.legendary: Was jiggled once so perfectly by grandad that it never ran again, and grandad now offers his jiggle to the whole street.

lore.common: Waves its flame so wildly in the wind that everyone keeps a safe distance.
lore.uncommon: Hangs on the castle wall in an iron holder, just like in the stories.
lore.rare: Throws a shadow twice the size of whoever holds it, so every tour guide looks like a giant.
lore.epic: Lit the whole castle for the torchlight tour, and the suits of armour stood up straighter to be seen.
lore.legendary: Burned so brightly in the great hall that the castle ghost asked for a dimmer switch.

lore.common: Is always full when someone is in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Has a drawstring that snaps the moment you pull it, so every bag gets tied by its own ears.
lore.rare: Is always just too big for the bin it's supposed to go in.
lore.epic: Was carried down every flat's stairs on bin day, and the lift was full of rubbish.
lore.legendary: Held so much rubbish that it was mistaken for a beanbag at the street party and sat on all evening. It held.

lore.common: Gets stuck mid-swivel so the camera points at the ground.
lore.uncommon: Has a handle that sticks out exactly where the photographer's elbow wants to be.
lore.rare: Turns so smoothly that it secretly swings the camera towards the ice cream van in every holiday video.
lore.epic: Turned slowly round a whole mountain range, and the panorama filled a whole wall.
lore.legendary: Turned so slowly to film one sunrise that it filmed the sunset as well, and called it a very long video.

names.legendary: The Stall With the Best View

lore.common: Flushes by itself whenever someone walks past, so everybody jumps.
lore.uncommon: Has a smelly block in it that never seems to shrink.
lore.rare: Is always the wrong height for half the people using it.
lore.epic: Was used by every football fan at half-time, and the queue went round the stadium.
lore.legendary: Has a little window with a view of the mountains, the best in the whole country.

lore.common: Gets a quick hair check from everyone leaving the house.
lore.uncommon: Is used for selfies so often that it has fingerprints at selfie height.
lore.rare: Shows the room as it looked this morning, so the tidied hallway always looks messy.
lore.epic: Was used by so many guests checking their hair that by ten o'clock the hallway had run out of reflection.
lore.legendary: Bounced the hallway light so far down the stairs that it lit the cellar, and the cellar spiders put on sunglasses.

lore.common: Eats logs so fast that someone has to keep going out into the snow.
lore.uncommon: Has a glass door that shows the dancing flames.
lore.rare: Toasts bread through its glass door just by staring at it, so the toast is always ready before anyone wanted any.
lore.epic: Got so hot during the snowstorm that the snow round the cottage melted into a moat, and the postman arrived by canoe.
lore.legendary: Kept a mountain hut so warm that a family of marmots knocked every evening and asked to sit by it.
